TheRocket SGrid - release build
===============================

  Automatic XAUUSD grid. It runs on its own: you set three things and leave it.
  For the version where every filter is exposed, ask for TheRocket SGrid Pro.
  For the one you drive by hand from your phone, ask for TheRocket MegiSemi.

FILES
  TheRocketSGrid.ex5   the Expert Advisor - this is the only file to install
  INSTALL.txt          this file

INSTALL
  1. In MT5: File > Open Data Folder > MQL5 > Experts
  2. Copy TheRocketSGrid.ex5 into that folder
  3. Back in MT5: right-click Navigator > Refresh

FIRST RUN
  1. Open a XAUUSD chart and switch it to M5. The EA needs M5.
  2. Drag the EA onto the chart.
  3. In the properties window tick:
       Allow Algo Trading
       Allow DLL imports        (needed for the licence check on a real account)
  4. Press the Algo Trading button on the MT5 toolbar so it turns green.

SETTINGS
  Only three are exposed:
       Grid step        distance between ladder levels, in points (150 tested)
       Max levels       how deep the ladder may go (80 tested)
       Auto scale lots  grow the lots with the balance (off by default)
  Everything else is locked to the tested 50k configuration.

LICENCE
  Strategy Tester / Demo      free, no time limit, no network at all
  Real account, licensed      no time limit
  Real account, unlicensed    10 days from the first run, after which the EA
                              opens no new basket - baskets already open are
                              still managed until they close

  To be licensed, send your MT5 account number. It unlocks within 5 minutes;
  there is no new file to install.

RISK
  This EA averages down and has no stop loss by design. The risk it carries is
  the whole account, not a fixed amount per trade. Use money you can afford to
  lose entirely and keep the lots small. Past results do not describe the
  future: testing was done on a window in which gold rose strongly, and the
  same settings lost money in other periods.
